usage: 電影院 means 'cinema' or 'movie theatre' and refers to the place where people go to watch films on a big screen.
It is a noun, and it is often used with the classifier 間, for example: 一間電影院 (a cinema) or 呢間電影院 (this cinema).
It commonly appears after verbs such as 去 and 喺, for example: 去電影院 (go to the cinema) or 喺電影院睇戲 (watch a film at the cinema).
This word is useful when talking about plans, locations, or outings, and common phrases include 電影院附近 (near the cinema) and 電影院門口 (the entrance of the cinema).
